newsitem.title: CHINA: China economic tsar ill, cancels meetings.
newsitem.headline: China economic tsar ill, cancels meetings.

text.p: China's chief economic strategist Zhu Rongji has cancelled meetings with foreign officials because of ill health, diplomats said on Tuesday.
They said they had been told Vice-Premier Zhu, 68, was hospitalised with influenza or light pneumonia. Chinese government officials had no immediate word on his health.
Zhu cancelled meetings with visiting British Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke and International Monetary Fund chief Michel Camdessus on Saturday.
The man who has been instrumental in returning economic power to the central government was not seen at a session of the National People's Congress, or parliament, on Monday.

Zhu has been instrumental in pushing for a rebuilding of the central government's economic power, much of it relinquished to regional authorities in the early days of reform in a bid to spur development.
He has also been a key figure in promoting greater regulation of the nation's financial markets.
